definitions.gloss: light spending; small in-app payments (gaming slang)
definitions.explanation: Spending only small amounts of real money on in-game or in-app purchases. Contrasts with {無|む}{課金|かきん} (spending nothing) and {重|じゅう}{課金|かきん} (heavy spending).

examples.japanese: {微|び}{課金|かきん}で{楽|たの}しんでいる。
examples.english: I enjoy the game with only light spending.

examples.japanese: {毎月|まいつき}{微|び}{課金|かきん}する{程度|ていど}だ。
examples.english: I only spend a little each month.

examples.japanese: {無|む}{課金|かきん}ではなく{微|び}{課金|かきん}で{強|つよ}いキャラを{少|すこ}しずつ{集|あつ}めている。
examples.english: Rather than spending nothing, I gather strong characters little by little with small payments.

notes:
A gaming and app slang term: {微|び} (slight) + {課金|かきん} (paying, being charged). Describes a player who spends only small sums on microtransactions.

RELATED TERMS:
- {無|む}{課金|かきん}: playing without spending any money
- {重|じゅう}{課金|かきん}: heavy spending
- {廃|はい}{課金|かきん}: extreme, excessive spending
- {課金|かきん}する: to pay for in-app content
